clips.title: The story
paras: Kolkar centaur watch the southern Durotar flats from Kolkar Crag, a gorge they have claimed for their raids. Warlord Kolkanis leads them against nearby Horde settlements.

Kolkar centaur hold a fortified gorge in southern Durotar. They guard its natural choke points and watch the surrounding flats for openings in orc and Darkspear holdings. Scouts and marauders range from the crag, probing those defenses. For young warriors training in the Valley of Trials and patrols along the southern coast, this is the nearest organized centaur threat.
